# Block/command instruction forms

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/generate-instruction-reference; do not edit by hand. -->

This page is generated from the canonical PTO catalogs under `spec/catalog/`.

Block/command forms update the block descriptor, block arguments, block-visible attributes, and block-control transfer state. They are encoded instruction forms, not direct tile selectors.
